kiro-cli headless stdout capture - provenance record

This directory holds one byte-exact capture of a single kiro-cli turn's
standard output. It is read only by test code; a testdata/ directory is
excluded from every Go build, so the file never reaches the compiled binary.

Runtime:      kiro-cli 2.21.2
Captured:     2026-09-10
Command:      kiro-cli chat --no-interactive --wrap never -- "List exactly three primary colors, one per line, no other text."
Exit code:    0
Stderr:       carried the credits trailer; not captured here

The capture does not end in a newline. That is the shape kiro-cli produces:
the last stdout line of a zero-exit turn is unterminated, and a copy written
with a trailing byte would not reproduce the runtime. A test asserts both the
digest below and the absent final newline, so an editor that normalizes the
file fails rather than passes.

Format: each asset line below has the form
  <relative-file-path> <byte-count> sha256:<hex-digest>
fields are separated by a single space; the hex digest is lowercase and
follows the literal prefix "sha256:".

turn_stdout.txt 48 sha256:af6cd348093979a59e45c26a0c0de4095871d534781f55eebfe0b010cf10a227
